products.product_description: Kinnikinnick Gluten Free Original Homestyle Waffles Frozen Contains a logos on the package indicating it is gluten free, dairy free, and nut free. 210 g/7.4oz Qty/pkg - 6. UPC 62013300198 1. DPI item # 55844.
products.reason_for_recall: DPI Specialty Foods NW is recalling Kinnikinnick Brand gluten free original homestyle waffles because they have the potential to contain the allergen milk, which is not declared on the label. Package contains a logo which indicates the product is dairy free.
